title: First-time renters, unfamiliar with SG terms
persona: Aisha & Ben, mid-20s couple, new grads starting their first jobs.
situation: Never rented before; confused by local jargon (HDB vs condo, master room, agent fee).

turns.content: hey we're a couple looking for our first place together, budget maybe $2500ish total
honestly we don't really get the difference between HDB and condo... which is better for us?
what's an 'agent fee'? do we have to pay that?
ok let's say HDB is fine. we both work in Jurong East. what can we get?
is a whole flat better than just renting a master room for two people?
